title: Normalized scalar tensor comparison at a ramified finite level
statement: Let ell be prime, E,L finite extensions of Q_ell, iota:E→L an embedding, and W a scheme. Let P,Q be arbitrary integer cochain complexes of completed E-coefficient sheaves, and n≥0. Use the ordinary scalar functor F and finite total tensor levels T^E_n,T^L_m of [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models, lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. There exist m≥n and an isomorphism d:F(T^E_n(P,Q))≅T^L_m(FP,FQ). For every bidegree (p,q), local sections x∈P^p(U), y∈Q^q(U), d sends 1⊗((1⊗x)⊗(1⊗y)) at E-level n to (1⊗(1⊗x))⊗(1⊗(1⊗y)) at L-level m. All tensors are the specified sheafified balanced tensors, and all totals are direct sums. No boundedness, completeness, flatness, tower morphism, Roos complex, or quasi-isomorphism assertion is part of this finite-level statement.

source.place: Tensor products and change of rings, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict (Tag 03EL); sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A4; parent proof steps 1 and 2, the ramified quotient calculation.

proof.text: Use the cochain change-of-rings model, identifying its ordinary functor with integralOrdinaryScalar by the fixed object and morphism formulas. The completed scalar ramification calculation gives a positive integer e and a unit section u with phi(t_E)=u*t_L^e.

For an arbitrary complex Z, use the augmentation-preserving principal quotient tower comparison on each coefficient field. The balanced principal quotient tower comparison identifies scalar extension of the source quotient at n with the target quotient at m=e*(n+1)-1, preserving the quotient maps. Conjugating by the two actual/principal quotient comparisons gives an isomorphism F(reduction_E,n(Z)) to reduction_L,m(F(Z)) which carries F of the actual reduction augmentation to the target augmentation. This is proved for arbitrary Z, without K-flatness.

Take Z to be the ordinary direct-sum total tensor of P and Q. The normalized tensorTowerModel identifies each recorded finite tensor with reduction of that ordinary tensor. Compose the scalar extension of the inverse source identification, the reduction isomorphism of step 2, reduction of the normalized ordinary scalar tensor chain isomorphism, and the target tensor identification. The resulting isomorphism has the required endpoints. Positivity of e implies n<=e*(n+1)-1.

Compose each reduction augmentation with its normalized tensor tower identification. Functoriality, the augmentation equation of step 2, and naturality of the target reduction augmentation show that F of the source composite followed by the constructed isomorphism equals the ordinary scalar tensor isomorphism followed by the target composite. Evaluate this equation on 1 tensor the pure bidegree generator. Scalar section naturality and the three published normalization formulas give exactly the asserted equation. The proof applies unchanged to zero inputs, the empty site, and n=0; e=1 gives m=n.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarTensorRamifiedLevel (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_h : n ≤ m)
      (d : ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n).obj (P, Q)) ≅
        (integralOperationsTensorLevel l L W m).obj
          ((((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
            (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))),
      ∀ (p q : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        (d.hom.f (p + q)).val.app U
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W _ U 1
            (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E W n P Q p q U
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (P.X p) U 1 x)
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (Q.X q) U 1 y))) =
        integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l L W m
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q U
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l L W m
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).obj (P.X p)) U 1
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W (P.X p) U 1 x))
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l L W m
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).obj (Q.X q)) U 1
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W (Q.X q) U 1 y))
